parsed.reason: Facts are all correct and complete: PD Day, tomorrow/Monday, 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM, Northside community centre, no invented details, correct AM, and it is clearly something to be at. But it reads like a calendar readout: a title-then-day-then-time label ('PD Day, Monday 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM at...'), with 'Heads-up for tomorrow' followed by redundant 'Monday', and the bare title dropped in after a colon. A friend would text it more like 'PD Day is tomorrow, 9:30 to 12 at the Northside community centre.' Falls under the notification-style cap, so at most 3.
